{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Leaf River Energy Center Header Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2023-06-22/pdf/2023-13264.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-11-18/pdf/2025-20186.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from New Home Salt Dome storage facility, Smith County, Mississippi to Clarke County, Mississippi.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-05-08/pdf/E8-10198.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2007/10/29/E7-21230.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Leaf River Energy Center LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-11-18/pdf/2025-20186.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''43.7 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2008-05-08/pdf/E8-10198.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2023-06-22/pdf/2023-13264.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-11-18/pdf/2025-20186.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
